podcast.title: Leading Interpreter of Medieval Music
podcast.body: Jordi Savall is arguably the greatest recuperator and interpreter of medieval music. He extensively studies ancient sources and performs using original instruments or faithful replicas, offering meticulously researched and historically informed insights into how this music might have truly sounded. "Seguramente es su mayor recuperador e interpretece al catalán Jordi Sabai, que estudia esas fuentes y toca con instrumentos originales o réplicas fieles."
